CustomField.description: Percentage the fees increase at renewal (e.g. 5 for "increased by five percent (5%)"). May be stated on the Order Form, buried in the MSA, or absent. When the contract expresses a cap like "the lesser of 5% or CPI", store the stated numeric percent (5). Null when no renewal escalator is specified. Evidence recorded in Extract_Evidence__c.
CustomField.label: Renewal Fee Escalator
